notes: a ToolHive audit event is one JSON log line written by the MCP proxy at its AUDIT level: who (subjects), what (type and target), where (component) and when (logged_at), with an outcome of success, failure, error, denied or application_error; it is the proxy's record of an operation, not a decision record

the line carries no signature, digest or chain member, so alg, signature and receiptAsserted are absent, and its outcome is the producer's word: it is lifted as advisory and never becomes outcomeDerived
custody starts at ingestion: sealing fixes these bytes from the moment they are ingested and says nothing about what happened, or what the log held, before that
the line has no link to a policy decision or a request attestation, so backLink is absent and a verifier cannot tell from it why the call was allowed or denied
subjects carries the display name taken from the caller's token claims, which can be an email address; it is lifted as it stands, so redact it before ingest where that matters
